high_level_description: This image appears to be a photograph taken on an Instagram Explore page. The image itself shows a tree planted on a sidewalk near a street. The tree casts a shadow that extends across the sidewalk, creating a pattern of branches and leaves. The shadow is quite detailed, suggesting that the sun was at a low angle when the photo was taken, possibly during early morning or late afternoon.
